text:
Transthoracic echocardiogram.
Indication: on trastuzumab, 3-monthly cardiac surveillance.
Findings: Left ventricle normal in size. LVEF 57% (baseline 62%). No regional wall motion abnormality. Valves structurally normal.
Conclusion: LVEF within normal limits with a small fall from baseline. Continue trastuzumab. Repeat echocardiogram in 12 weeks as per surveillance protocol; this will be performed at Valeford Hospitals cardio-oncology service.

Bilateral mammography.
History: left wide local excision 2023.
Findings: Post-surgical changes in the left breast, stable. No suspicious mass, calcification or architectural distortion. Right breast normal.
Conclusion: No mammographic evidence of recurrence. Continue annual mammographic surveillance.

Screening assessment.
Right breast: 9 mm irregular mass at 10 o'clock. Ultrasound shows a hypoechoic irregular lesion, U4.
Conclusion: R4/U4 - suspicious. Recommend urgent ultrasound-guided core biopsy.

Ultrasound left breast.
Findings: 14 mm well-circumscribed oval hypoechoic lesion, parallel orientation, likely fibroadenoma. Graded U3 (indeterminate) given patient age.
Conclusion: Recommend core biopsy for histological confirmation.

Ultrasound right breast.
Findings: 8 mm simple cyst at 2 o'clock. No solid component.
Conclusion: U2 benign. No further imaging required; return to routine screening.

Echocardiogram.
Indication: on trastuzumab and pertuzumab.
Findings: LVEF 47% (previous 61%), an absolute fall of 14 percentage points. Mild global hypokinesis.
Conclusion: Significant fall in LVEF meeting criteria for cardiotoxicity. Recommend urgent cardio-oncology review and repeat echo in 3 weeks. Oncology team informed by telephone.

DXA scan.
Indication: on letrozole since 2025.
Findings: Lumbar spine T-score -1.8. Total hip T-score -1.4.
Conclusion: Osteopenia. Recommend repeat DXA in 2 years.

DXA scan.
Indication: on anastrozole.
Findings: L1-L4 T-score -2.7. Femoral neck T-score -2.1.
Conclusion: Osteoporosis at the lumbar spine. Bone health clinic review advised within 6 weeks regarding bisphosphonate therapy. Repeat DXA in 12 months.

CT chest, abdomen and pelvis (staging).
Findings: No axillary or mediastinal lymphadenopathy. A 6 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe, nonspecific. Liver, adrenals and bones unremarkable.
Conclusion: No evidence of metastatic disease. Indeterminate 6 mm pulmonary nodule; suggest follow-up CT chest in 3 months to assess stability given oncological history.

CT chest, abdomen and pelvis.
Findings: There is a 12 mm low-attenuation lesion in segment 7 of the liver which is too small to characterise; MRI liver within 4 weeks would be helpful. Lungs clear. No bone lesions.
Conclusion: No definite metastatic disease.

CT chest.
Findings: Previously noted 5 mm nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared with the 2024 CT, now stable over 2 years.
Conclusion: Benign behaviour. No further follow-up of the nodule is required.

Echocardiogram.
Indication: baseline prior to trastuzumab.
Findings: LVEF 64%. Normal study.
Conclusion: Proceed with treatment; next surveillance echo in 3 months.

Mammography.
History: right mastectomy 2022.
Findings: Left breast scattered fibroglandular density. A few benign-appearing calcifications, unchanged.
Conclusion: M2 benign. Annual mammography of the left breast as per surveillance programme.

Surveillance mammography.
History: left wide local excision 2024.
Findings: New area of architectural distortion at the scar site, not seen on the 2025 study.
Conclusion: M4 - suspicious. Recommend further assessment with ultrasound and core biopsy; refer to breast clinic urgently.

Ultrasound left axilla.
Findings: A 9 mm lymph node with slightly thickened cortex (3.5 mm). Possibly reactive following recent vaccination.
Conclusion: Consider repeat ultrasound in 6 weeks if clinically indicated.

TTE: LVEF 55%, GLS -17%. Rx: T-DM1.
Imp: borderline GLS reduction (-21% to -17%).
Plan: rpt TTE 6/52.

Diagnostic mammogram.
Indication: left breast pain.
Findings: No mass, no suspicious calcification.
Conclusion: M1 normal. No imaging follow-up required. Return to GP.

DXA baseline before starting anastrozole.
Findings: T-scores spine -0.6, hip -0.4. Normal bone mineral density.
Conclusion: Repeat DXA in 2 years while on aromatase inhibitor.

MRI breasts (extent of disease).
Known 18 mm right breast carcinoma. A 6 mm enhancing focus in the left breast at 2 o'clock, indeterminate (MRI 3).
Conclusion: Recommend second-look ultrasound of the left breast within 2 weeks.

CT chest, abdomen and pelvis (restaging, metastatic breast cancer).
Findings: Interval decrease in size of liver metastases. Stable sclerotic bone lesions. New 4 mm nodule in the right middle lobe, likely of no significance, but attention on next restaging CT in 3 months is suggested.
Conclusion: Partial response.

Echocardiogram.
Indication: on trastuzumab, cycle 9.
Findings: LVEF 60%, stable.
Conclusion: Continue 3-monthly echo surveillance until completion of trastuzumab.

MRI liver.
Findings: 15 mm lesion in segment 4 shows features of a haemangioma.
Conclusion: Benign haemangioma. No further imaging is necessary.

Ultrasound left breast for palpable lump.
Findings: 22 mm irregular hypoechoic mass with posterior shadowing, U5. Left axillary node with effaced hilum.
Conclusion: Highly suspicious of malignancy. Recommend urgent core biopsy of the breast mass and axillary node.

DXA scan.
Indication: on exemestane.
Findings: Spine T-score -2.2 (previously -1.9).
Conclusion: Osteopenia with interval decline. Repeat DXA in 1 year.

Echocardiogram.
Findings: LVEF 58%, stable. Trastuzumab course completed.
Conclusion: No further echocardiographic surveillance required.

Mammogram after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
Findings: Marker clip in satisfactory position.
Conclusion: No follow-up imaging needed before surgery.

CT neck and chest.
Findings: Incidental 15 mm left thyroid nodule. Lungs clear.
Conclusion: Recommend non-urgent thyroid ultrasound within 3 months.

Ultrasound left axilla.
Performed as the 6-week follow-up recommended on the previous study. The previously seen node now has a normal cortex.
Conclusion: Resolved reactive node. No further follow-up required.
